title: Structures of NF-κB p52 homodimer-DNA complexes rationalize binding mechanisms and transcription activation
authors: Vladimir A. Meshcheryakov; Wenfei Pan; Tianjie Li; Yi Wang; Gourisankar Ghosh; Vivien Ya-Fan Wang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NF-κB p52同源二聚体与不同κB DNA复合物的晶体结构和MD模拟，揭示了DNA构象动态与结合动力学对转录激活的调控机制，高度契合TF-DNA互作机制建模课题。
abstract: The mammalian NF-κB p52:p52 homodimer together with its cofactor Bcl3 activates transcription of κB sites with a central G/C base pair (bp), while it is inactive toward κB sites with a central A/T bp. To understand the molecular basis for this unique property of p52, we have determined its structure in complex with a P-selectin(PSel)-κB DNA (5’-GGGGT G ACCCC-3’) (central bp is underlined) and variants changing the central bp to A/T or swapping the flanking bp. The structures reveal a nearly two-fold widened minor groove in the central region of the DNA as compared to all other currently available NF-κB-DNA complex structures, which have a central A/T bp. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations show free DNAs exist in distinct preferred conformations, and p52:p52 homodimer induces the least amount of conformational changes on the more transcriptionally active natural PSel-κB DNA in the bound form. Our binding assays further demonstrate that the fast kinetics driven by entropy is correlated with higher transcriptional activity. Overall, our studies have revealed a novel conformation for κB DNA in complex with NF-κB and suggest the importance of binding kinetics, dictated by free DNA conformational and dynamic states, in controlling transcriptional activation for NF-κB.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物NF-κB p52:p52同源二聚体与其辅因子Bcl3共同激活具有中心G/C碱基对（bp）的κB位点的转录，而对中心A/T碱基对的κB位点则无活性。为理解p52这一独特性质的分子基础，我们测定了其与P-选择素(PSel)-κB DNA（5’-GGGGT G ACCCC-3’）（中心碱基对以下划线标示）及改变中心碱基对为A/T或交换侧翼碱基对的变体的复合物结构。结构显示，与所有其他目前可用的具有中心A/T碱基对的NF-κB-DNA复合物结构相比，该DNA中心区域的次要沟宽度几乎增大两倍。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟表明，游离DNA以不同的优选构象存在，且p52:p52同源二聚体在结合形式中对转录活性更高的天然PSel-κB DNA诱导的构象变化最小。我们的结合实验进一步证明，由熵驱动的快速动力学与更高的转录活性相关。总体而言，我们的研究揭示了与NF-κB复合的κB DNA的一种新型构象，并提示由游离DNA构象和动态状态决定的结合动力学在控制NF-κB转录激活中的重要性。
